concerns.text: FR-001 references "(See US-1)" but no identifier US-1 is defined anywhere; the user stories are labeled "User Story 1" etc. This cross‑reference is unresolved.
Multiple functional requirements (FR-001 to FR-007) cite "US-1", "US-2", and "US-3" which do not exist. The spec uses "User Story" headings, creating a terminology mismatch and breaking traceability.

FR-006 mandates a hard runtime budget of ≤6 hours on a 2‑core, 7 GB RAM runner with no GPU usage, yet the Assumptions describe a grid‑search over 12 (τ, k) combos for each of 500 training clips with 10 episodes per combo (≈ 60 000 episodes). This workload is highly likely to exceed the stated budget, creating a direct conflict between a functional requirement and the proposed methodology.
